translator_notes: Wedding song as a dialogue between the wedding party and the host; origin unclear, I cannot name an author. 'тук' сме' is read as 'but we have', my reading.

lines.en: - Host, do you have red wine,
do you have three-year-old strong rakija,
to welcome dear guests, wedding guests,

lines.cyr: од далеку и од блиску дојдени?
lines.lat: od daleku i od blisku dojdeni?
lines.en: come from far and from near?
Let the drums beat,
so that the villagers hear,
let the whole village drink,

lines.cyr: сè до капка да се испие.
lines.lat: sè do kapka da se ispie.
lines.en: until the last drop is drunk.
- Please, dear guests, dear wedding guests,

lines.cyr: јас си имам тригодишна лута ракија,
lines.lat: jas si imam trigodišna luta rakija,
lines.en: I have three-year-old strong rakija,

lines.cyr: ем си имам рујно вино црвено,
lines.lat: em si imam rujno vino crveno,
lines.en: and I also have ruby red wine,

lines.cyr: да пречекам до три села големи.
lines.lat: da prečekam do tri sela golemi.
lines.en: to welcome up to three big villages.
Let the drums beat,
so that the villagers hear,
let the whole village drink,

lines.cyr: сè до капка да се испие.
lines.lat: sè do kapka da se ispie.
lines.en: until the last drop is drunk.

lines.cyr: - Домаќине, не сме дошле за да пиеме
lines.lat: - Domaḱine, ne sme došle za da pieme
lines.en: - Host, we have not come to drink
ruby wine or three-year-old strong rakija,

lines.cyr: тук' сме дошле по невеста убава
lines.lat: tuk' sme došle po nevesta ubava
lines.en: but we have come for a beautiful bride
for our dear child, our dearest.
Let the drums beat,
so that the villagers hear,
let the whole village drink,

lines.cyr: сè до капка да се испие.
lines.lat: sè do kapka da se ispie.
lines.en: until the last drop is drunk.
